item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
What's new in 1.1.2

**A much more readable Graph**

  • Big bundles open as one circle per folder (or type), with the number of concepts inside. Double-click a circle to drill into it; **Zoom out** or Esc steps back.
  • Double-click a concept to see it with all its connections, without leaving the graph. *Open note ›* in its details opens the editor.
  • Filter by folder, status, stale, trust tier and tag from the Filter menu; filters hide instead of dim, and a strip says what is hidden.
  • Names are written inside the circles; hover a circle to see it enlarged with its full name.
  • The folder's own `index.md` is shown in the details of a folder circle.

**OKF**

  • A bundle is recognised from its notes (or `okf_version`) and behaves as OKF straight away: there is no "declare" step any more.
  • The OKF actions moved from the menu bar to an **OKF** toolbar button, enabled only in an OKF bundle (shortcuts ⌥⌘P, ⌥⌘V, ⌥⌘N unchanged).

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
What's new in 1.1.1

  • **Graph view** (View ▸ Graph, ⌘3): the whole vault as an interactive, read-only graph of concepts and their links, with search, a type filter, five layouts and a detail pane. It also shows front-matter source edges.
  • The sidebar now shows file extensions (`Customers.md`, not `Customers`).

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
What is new in 1.1.0

  • Vault tabs: open several vaults at once; they are remembered across launches
  • Sync button: save, receive and send in one press; sidebar badges; folder and note Commit & Push, Pull and .gitignore actions
  • Git activity pane with live progress
  • The vault folder is the top of the file tree
  • Review comments on notes, stored as event files so Git merges never conflict
  • Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.2): properties form, verification, checker, index.md and log.md tools, markdown links
  • The Markdown tab is now a full WYSIWYG editor
  • Built-in updates (this one)
